original.title: Production Monitoring with Codex: Grafana, Kubernetes, & Security
original.summary: OpenAI presenters walk through three bounded production-response scenarios: a checkout failure correlated with Grafana and recent changes, a Kubernetes rollout with out-of-memory restarts, and shared-worker exhaustion treated as an availability issue. The segment emphasizes reconstructing evidence before proposing patches, human review before high-impact changes, and replay-based validation after remediation. These are demonstrations, not independent incident-resolution benchmarks; summary derives from a complete indexed original-language transcript, not watched playback.
original.why_it_matters: Use telemetry and change history as controlled context, then review and regression-test each suggested operational patch.

video.title: Reimagine business productivity with AI agents and assistants
video.summary: IBM AI Academy presenter Parul Mishra explains how AI assistants differ from AI agents and how both can support enterprise knowledge work. The episode considers choosing the appropriate form of assistance or automation for a business use case. This evergreen educational overview is not an independent productivity benchmark; the synopsis is based on IBM's published episode description.
video.why_it_matters: Match the level of automation to one clearly defined task before deploying an agent. Use the distinction between assistants and agents to identify where employees need support, where actions require approval, and what outcomes to measure.
